extracted.name: Chipotle Honey Vinaigrette
extracted.description: This chipotle vinaigrette is sweet, smoky, and spicy. Use it as a salad dressing, or drizzle it over grilled or roasted veggies, tacos, bowls, and more!
ingredient_lines: 1 chipotle pepper from a can of chipotles in adobo
instruction_lines: In a small food processor, combine the oil, lime juice, chipotle, honey, garlic, cumin, salt, and several grinds of pepper. Pulse until combined.
See the above blog post for serving suggestions.
